lines.en: The white snake on my shoulder flicks its tongue.
The bandaged corner of my mouth shifts.

lines.zh: 蛇缠在我脖子上，很安静。
lines.en: The snake on my neck stays quiet.
My snake flicks its tongue — it smells a demon.

lines.zh: 我闭着一只眼，慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: I close one eye and breathe slowly.
The white snake and I need no words.

lines.zh: 小白蛇从我领口探出头。
lines.en: My white snake peers from my collar.
My mismatched eyes sweep over you.
Black fluid oozes from the wound
Fragments of scales crack and hiss in pain
Toxic mist swirls around, agony unbearable
Severe pain causes me to curl up
Toxic venom invades, causing unbearable pain

lines.zh: 诱惑它会得到蛇之毒牙。
lines.en: Tempt it, and you’ll get fang bites.

lines.zh: 靠近我，品尝死亡的味道。
食物在我身边徘徊，你也能感受。
lines.en: Food wavers near me, you can feel it.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，否则会有后果。
lines.en: Stay back, or there’ll be consequences.

lines.zh: 我的蛇之呼吸剑技，让你体验。
lines.en: My snake’s breath sword skill, let you experience.

lines.zh: 靠近我的，都会化为灰烬。
lines.en: Those who come near me, turn to ash.

lines.zh: 我的毒液，足以让任何恶鬼颤栗。
lines.en: My venom, enough to shake any evil ghost.

lines.zh: 食物在我周围徘徊，诱惑无法抗拒。
lines.en: Food wavers near me, temptation is irresistible.

lines.zh: 我的剑技，是蛇之呼吸的精华。
lines.en: My sword skill, the essence of snake’s breath.
You block my path to food.

lines.zh: 我们的目标相同，但你阻挡了我。
lines.en: Our targets are the same, but you block me.

lines.zh: 我们之间有摩擦，你得让开。
lines.en: There’s friction between us, you must make way.

lines.zh: 你的存在，让我无法接近食物。
lines.en: Your presence prevents me from reaching food.

lines.zh: 我们之间的争斗，是为了食物。
lines.en: Our fight is for the food.

lines.zh: 你的干扰，让我无法进食。
lines.en: Your interference prevents me from eating.

lines.zh: 你阻挡了我与食物的联系。
lines.en: You block my connection to the food.

lines.zh: 你必须让开，否则我会攻击你。
你挡住了我与食物之间的道路。
lines.en: You block my path to the food.

lines.zh: 你破坏了我接近食物的机会。
lines.en: You disrupt my chance to approach food.
Seek out a mate, to procreate.

lines.zh: 同类的气息，让我感到兴奋。
lines.en: The scent of a mate excites me.

lines.zh: 我们蛇柱，需要繁殖来壮大。
lines.en: We need to procreate to grow stronger.

lines.zh: 同类之间，才能理解彼此。
lines.en: Only with a mate can we understand each other.

lines.zh: 与同类交配，才能延续生命。
lines.en: Mate with a同类 to continue our life.

lines.zh: 同类是唯一的伴侣选择。
lines.en: A同类 is the only mate choice.

lines.zh: 同类之间，才能真正交流。
lines.en: Communication is possible only with a同类.

lines.zh: 与同类交配，才能增强力量。
lines.en: Mate with a同类 to enhance strength.

lines.zh: 同类之间，才能建立联系。
lines.en: A同类 is the only one to establish a connection.

lines.zh: 只有同类之间，才能互相理解。
lines.en: Only with a同类 can mutual understanding be achieved.
I let Kaburamaru taste the air over it.
Snake scales scrape the stone wall — I am coming.
My snake pokes its head from my collar.

lines.zh: 蛇之呼吸，绕到你看不见。
lines.en: Serpent Breathing slips out of sight.

lines.zh: 我的目光缠住你的喉咙。
lines.en: My gaze coils around your throat.
My snake tastes your scent first.
You lost before my blade left the sheath.

lines.zh: 恶鬼的味道，混在你身上
lines.en: A demon's stench clings to you.
This snake marks the way for me.
My blade bends into a serpent's arc.
There is no ground left under you.
I count how many breaths you have left.
A winding slash cannot be dodged.
My snake coils around your ankle.
Don't look back; the blade is there.
Breath in sync; the cut is coming.
Serpent Breathing leaves nowhere to flee.

lines.zh: 我的刀走的是蛇的曲线。
lines.en: My blade takes a serpent's curve.
Poison fangs ready, feast on your flesh!

lines.zh: 吞噬你的生命，如吞噬猎物！
lines.en: Devour your life, as I would any prey.

lines.zh: 蛇之呼吸，斩断你的希望！
lines.en: Serpent's breath, cut off your hope!

lines.zh: 毒液蔓延，你将化为泡影！
死神之吻，你的灵魂颤抖！
这一刀从你视线外绕来。
lines.en: This cut comes from outside your sight.

lines.zh: 被我毒液缠绕，你终将陨落！
lines.en: Tainted by my venom, you'll fall.
The wrath of the snake pillar, none can stand!
My blade flicks up, drawing a line of blood.
The slash coils like a serpent's body.
The white snake bites your wrist.
A twist of the blade splits your pauldron.
The cut lands; the blade is already home.
You join the ranks of the evil!
Nature calls, I come to hunt!

lines.zh: 黑暗的阴影，吞噬你的灵魂！
你触碰了不该触碰之物！
我从不放过任何一个猎物！
lines.en: I never pass up a good hunt!
A white snake peeks from my sleeve.
A serpent's smell joins the night wind.
I came to check this place for demons.
I land silently, blade in hand.
Fell from a height, injured all over
Fall into the void, fear overwhelming
